stories.title: Shivon Zilis posts Elon Musk's texts after their breakup
stories.summary: Hours after an alert account noticed Elon Musk had unfollowed Shivon Zilis, the mother of four of his children, she announced on X that he had ended their relationship: "It's hard to go from in love to let go in a week with no warning." She attached a screenshot of their texts, Musk's "Love you too" followed by "I didn't realize that this Xi dinner included significant other (Beijing one did not) or I would have invited you." Replies ranged from "Elon… my brother, what are you doing? Marry this woman immediately" to "are you free next weekend," and her Wikipedia page went from about 1K daily views to 28K, then 50K the next day.
